name: Squee, the Immortal
oracle_text: You may cast this card from your graveyard or from exile.
blocked_sentences: You may cast this card from your graveyard or from exile.

needs.what: a card's own printed, unconditional, permanent permission to cast itself from exile at its printed price (like the Gravecrawler-shaped own-graveyard permission, but with active_zones ["exile"]), read off the card while it sits in its owner's exile regardless of how it got there
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The graveyard half is the `cast_from_graveyard` static with active_zones ["graveyard"], which the loader restricts to the graveyard alone (own_graveyard_cast_permission checks Zone.GRAVEYARD). Exile casts in casting._cast_actions come only from object-level grants (playable_by/playable_live set by exile/grant_playable effects, with durations like while_exiled), on_adventure, foretell, warp or rebound -- all granted by an effect or tied to a specific mechanic, none a printed characteristic that survives any route into exile. Writing only the graveyard half would be a partial card.
